title: Nomad Agent Passport
summary: Publish an AI agent passport on-chain: who controls it and which permission scopes it holds.
what: Nomad is an Anchor 0.31.1 program that gives each agent key a passport PDA listing a label and permission scopes. Only the passport authority can change or close it.
app_note: The page at /dapps/nomad-passport/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/nomad. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/nomad-passport/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call initialize_passport for any agent key.
try_steps.see: A passport PDA for that agent with your scopes.

diagram: authority --initialize_passport--> passport PDA(agent); authority --update_permissions--> scopes; authority --close_passport--> rent back
innovation: A portable, public permission record for an agent that any service can read without trusting the agent itself.
exercises: Why is the passport keyed by the agent and not by the authority?
How would a service check a scope like pay:usdc<=5 before acting?
